summary_en: First dividend: 15 yen per share (30 yen pre-split equivalent). Total payout ¥26.97M. Record date 2026-10-31, effective date 2027-01-29. Source: retained earnings. Rationale: stable recent earnings and balance-sheet strength now permit simultaneous growth investment and direct shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice regarding dividend of surplus (initial dividend)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-15, Ibis Holdings' board of directors resolved to pay the company's first dividend in its history. The dividend of 15 yen per share (equivalent to 30 yen on a pre-split basis) will be charged to retained earnings, with a record date of 2026-10-31 and an effective date of 2027-01-29. Total payout is ¥26.97M. The company states that historically it prioritized internal capital retention and reinvestment during its growth phase, but recent stable operational performance and balance-sheet strengthening now permit simultaneous pursuit of growth capex and direct shareholder returns.
